```python
def hohmann_delta_v(semi_major_axis1, semi_major_axis2, central_mass):
    G = 6.67430e-11  # Gravitational constant
    v1 = math.sqrt(G * central_mass / semi_major_axis1)  # Velocity in initial orbit
    v2 = math.sqrt(G * central_mass / semi_major_axis2)  # Velocity in final orbit
    v_transfer = math.sqrt(G * central_mass * (2 / semi_major_axis1 - 1 / ((semi_major_axis1 + semi_major_axis2) / 2)))
    delta_v1 = v_transfer - v1  # Delta-v for the first burn
    delta_v2 = v2 - v_transfer  # Delta-v for the second burn
    return delta_v1, delta_v2
```

```python
    G = 6.67430e-11  # Gravitational constant
```
